prompts.roof: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a single reusable transparent roof sprite for an actual 2.5D Chinese mountain-dojo life simulation. Primary request: ONLY one rustic grey-blue tiled Chinese cottage roof, no building walls, no landscape, no characters, no floor. Hand-painted storybook watercolor and gouache on textured paper, delicate irregular ink edges, moss in tile seams, pale weathered clay accents, warm afternoon light from upper left. Elevated orthographic view looking down about 50 degrees, front faces exactly toward the bottom edge with NO isometric yaw; the front eave is horizontal, the long ridge is horizontal, overall roof footprint is a broad rectangle, gently raised corner tips and visible dark wooden undersides along the lower eave. Roof occupies about 88 percent of image width and 65 percent of image height, centered with transparent padding all around; all contours complete. Natural tactile painting, not vector geometry, not pixel art, no diagram, no text, no watermark. Genuine transparent background. This is a separate roof layer: retain alpha holes at silhouette, no surrounding decorative scene or cast ground shadow.
prompts.tree: Use case: game asset. Create ONE reusable deciduous mountain tree sprite, entire tree including slender curved brown trunk rooted at the bottom center. A loose umbrella canopy of muted sage and olive leaves, delicate little branches, hand painted storybook watercolor and gouache on paper with irregular pigment edges. Elevated orthographic game view, looking downward about 50 degrees, trunk vertical, no isometric rotation. Natural graceful asymmetrical silhouette, warm afternoon light. Real transparent background, absolutely no colored backdrop, no vignette, no ground, no shadow under or around tree. No text, watermark, frame, people, buildings or other objects. Complete foliage contour with transparent padding. This is a separate alpha sprite rendered over an existing terrain.
prompts.bridge: Use case: game asset. One small rustic Chinese wooden footbridge sprite only, hand painted watercolor gouache with warm wood grain and sage moss, elevated orthographic camera looking down 50 degrees. Bridge runs horizontally left to right, crosses a stream that will be drawn separately. A simple rectangular deck of weathered planks, two low wooden rails on the upper and lower sides, short posts. No perspective yaw, exactly horizontal, whole silhouette visible and isolated. Genuine transparent background, no water, land, plants, shadows or colored vignette around it. No text or watermark. Gentle storybook tactile painting, not photorealistic, not vector. This sprite is a separate reusable foreground bridge over an editable game map.
